name: text-trouble
brief: Two columns of the customer table hold text, and both are wrong, in different ways. Support tickets mention strange characters in one and surnames that stop short in the other.
hints: There are two problems, in two different columns of one table.
One of them changes the length of the values, the other changes what they look like.
The email column has a recognisable format: has the format changed? The surname column has no format, only lengths.
